summary: Implement Release A observability for final-composer attempt kinds and repair causes without changing prompts, schemas, retry policy, models, rendering, or customer responses.
Release A started from clean origin/product commit 71b15cadf5d012ad58c0f42349dd96127ff09ae6 in isolated branch fix/runtime-v7-repair-observability-20260827; the customer-facing VM was not changed.

Normalized llm_span_log retains component and round but did not project explicit attempt_kind, repair_reason, or violation_types, so final-composer retry costs could not be grouped by stable repair cause.

Added analytics-only final-composer attempt labels while preserving component=final_composer and all existing prompt, model, response-format, token-limit, temperature, retry, renderer, and fallback behavior.
Focused deterministic validation passed 4 tests covering successful initial composition, initial format retry, contract repair plus repair-format retry, and normalized LLM-span metadata projection.
Focused Release A validation passed 5 tests, including every existing final-composer attempt category and normalized span projection.
The full Runtime V7 deterministic regression selection passed 1502 tests in 60.50 seconds; Ruff, compile, JSON, and diff checks passed.
Behavioral change audit passed with only the expected informational README confirmation. Deployment was not requested and the customer-facing runtime remains unchanged.

Staging build 323caeab-033f-4341-9e1d-ad4eed30df80 deployed d05b05c as revision gulong-chatbot-runtime-staging-00429-rh9 at 100 percent traffic; exact health, analytics-enabled return-only probes, normalized initial attempt_kind projection, and revision error checks passed.

The three-case live-model matrix passed 1 of 3 on staging and the same 1 of 3 on the pre-patch feb88a4 live baseline with matching delivery-policy and payment-contract failure categories; no Release A quality movement was observed.

Live build e0e87d06-1229-4912-8809-5d97de20f054 deployed 54eec74 as Cloud Run revision gulong-chatbot-runtime-live-00105-7tr at 100 percent traffic using immutable digest sha256:d2ef953b75c679073d35a853cc64872a892708daf87b4cc0428750a0f3bec8b7; exact health and normalized telemetry passed.

The exact live digest passed an alternate-port VM candidate check and replaced gulong-chatbot-runtime-shadow while preserving send_content, tags, and follow-up configuration; rollback container gulong-chatbot-runtime-shadow-rollback-feb88a4-20260827T1912PHT remains retained and shadow_services_json was updated to 54eec74.

Through 2026-08-27 19:17:36 Asia/Manila, the VM release had 8 completed rows: 5 successful real deliveries, 1 synthetic return-only skip, and 2 intentional suppressions, with zero failed statuses, tracebacks, exceptions, or restarts. Final-composer spans were initial attempts; no natural repair occurred in the bounded window.
